comparison.objective: Match lids to tins and replace each lid; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Shape matching, lid alignment, and closure seating differ from narrow-mandrel insertion, stabilized hammering, notch fracture, and tiny-fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Every tin correctly re-lidded is implied, but fit and seating thresholds are absent. Candidate requires four fractures and recovered tangs with inserts retained.
comparison.reason: Closure matching and seating do not test controlled impact fracture.
